sources.source: Judicial Appointments and Conduct Ombudsman annual report 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report was published on 13 July 2026 for England and Wales and includes performance data and statistics on complaints and investigations, expenditure, and commentary on complaint types during 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds judicial-complaint oversight context while retaining complaint-versus-investigation, appointment-versus-conduct, jurisdiction, expenditure and annual-performance-versus-system-harm guards.

sources.source: The Ombudsman's annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report was published on 15 July 2026 and covers performance, financial reporting and statistical information about complaints received during the preceding 12 months.
sources.quality_effect: Adds public-service and health-complaint oversight context while retaining complaint-versus-substantiated-finding, service-sector, case-mix, reporting-period and no-population-harm-rate guards.

sources.source: Financial Ombudsman Service Annual Report 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Financial Ombudsman Service and HM Treasury
sources.verified_fact: The annual report and accounts for 2025 to 2026 was published on 9 July 2026 and laid before Parliament under the Financial Services and Markets Act framework.
sources.quality_effect: Adds financial-consumer complaint resolution context while retaining complaint-versus-loss, jurisdiction, upheld-versus-received case, product mix and no-local-fraud-prevalence guards.

sources.source: Pensions Ombudsman and Pension Protection Fund Ombudsman annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: The Pensions Ombudsman and Pension Protection Fund Ombudsman
sources.verified_fact: The report covers 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, was published on 9 July 2026 and describes an impartial, free-at-point-of-delivery service whose primary function is handling pension complaints.
sources.quality_effect: Adds pension-consumer protection context while retaining complaint-versus-scheme-failure, ombudsman role, funding, pension-type and reporting-period guards.

sources.source: SFO Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26
sources.verified_fact: The official annual-report collection was updated on 16 July 2026 to add the Serious Fraud Office Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26.
sources.quality_effect: Adds serious-fraud agency governance context while retaining collection-page-versus-report-detail, investigation-versus-charge, case-versus-defendant, recovery-versus-loss and classified-case guards.

sources.source: HMRC annual report and accounts: 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 9 July 2026, covers performance from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, and is accompanied by an HTML executive summary, statistical tables and historical data series.
sources.quality_effect: Adds tax, customs and payment-system governance context while retaining transaction-versus-person, compliance-yield, detection, customer-group, reporting-year and no-local-crime-rate guards.

sources.source: HMRC annual report and accounts: 2025 to 2026 — technical notes
sources.verified_fact: The supplementary collection published on 9 July 2026 contains HTML technical notes for compliance yield, large business, wealthy and mid-sized business compliance, the Fraud Investigation Service, sanctions enforcement and customer-group taxation.
sources.quality_effect: Adds metric-definition and enforcement-scope controls while retaining yield-versus-cash, investigation-versus-conviction, sanctions case, customer group, methodology and double-counting guards.

sources.source: Public Sector Fraud Authority Annual Report 2024-2025
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 27 February 2026 in PDF and HTML and accounts for the authority's activities and performance against its 2024-25 objectives.
sources.quality_effect: Adds cross-government fraud-control context while retaining detected-versus-undetected fraud, prevention-versus-recovery, departmental coverage, objective-versus-outcome and reporting-year guards.

sources.source: GIAA Annual Report and Accounts 2025-2026
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 14 July 2026 and updated on 15 July with an accessible version; it covers agency performance against strategic objectives, objectives for the year ahead and financial results for 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds internal-control assurance context while retaining audit-coverage, assurance-opinion, client-body, objective-versus-control-effectiveness and corporate-performance guards.

sources.source: The Payment Systems Regulator Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Payment Systems Regulator and HM Treasury
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 9 July 2026 and summarises PSR activity under statutory objectives to promote competition and innovation and to consider the interests of businesses and consumers using payment systems.
sources.quality_effect: Adds payment-system consumer and market-resilience context while retaining regulator-activity-versus-fraud-loss, payment-system-versus-provider, innovation, competition and statutory-objective guards.

sources.source: ORR Annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026: Performance analysis
sources.verified_fact: The official performance analysis covers 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and records ORR work on safety certification during rail reform, overspeeding controls, level crossings, fatigue and extreme-weather risks to structures and operational property.
sources.quality_effect: Adds rail-safety regulatory intervention context while retaining regulator-action-versus-incident, operator, infrastructure, precursor-event, inspection and no-parcel-risk guards.

sources.source: Annual report of health and safety on Britain's railways 2025 to 2026: Non-mainline railways, digital safety, and safety by design
sources.verified_fact: The official report identifies operational resilience and incident-response lessons for the Channel Tunnel, variation in risk-control maturity across Transport for London, and broadly stable tram safety while noting remaining asset, platform-interface and occupational-health risks.
sources.quality_effect: Adds non-mainline rail and passenger-welfare context while retaining event-versus-trend, management-maturity, network type, precursor, exposure and publication-period guards.

sources.source: Annual report of health and safety on Britain's railways 2025 to 2026: Health and safety strategy, policy, and regulatory delivery
sources.verified_fact: The official report covers the ROGS framework review and records statutory activity including 1,523 new train-driving licences, 1,902 renewals, certificates and authorisations, and status reporting on 104 RAIB recommendations.
sources.quality_effect: Adds rail-framework and statutory-output context while retaining application-versus-person, licence-versus-competence, recommendation status, certificate scope and output-versus-safety-outcome guards.

sources.source: Ministry of Defence annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report was published and laid before Parliament on 15 July 2026 and contains performance analysis against departmental priority outcomes, accountability reporting, financial statements and supporting tables.
sources.quality_effect: Adds defence-governance context while retaining corporate-activity-versus-security-outcome, classified-detail, programme, expenditure, priority and reporting-year guards.

sources.source: Defence Equipment & Support annual report and accounts 2025-2026
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 15 July 2026, covers the year ending 31 March 2026 and states that DE&S received an unqualified audit opinion for the ninth consecutive year; equipment-programme costs remain captured in the MOD accounts.
sources.quality_effect: Adds defence-equipment delivery and audit context while retaining agency-versus-programme cost, audit-opinion-versus-operational-readiness, delivery-stage, security classification and reporting-boundary guards.

sources.source: SSRO Annual Report and Accounts 2025/26
sources.verified_fact: The official page was published on 9 July 2026 and is titled for the year ending 31 March 2026, while its details text refers to 2024/25; the internal period inconsistency is retained as a source-quality warning.
sources.quality_effect: Adds single-source defence-contract regulatory context while explicitly guarding title-versus-details mismatch, contract-versus-supplier, reporting-period and regulatory-output-versus-value-for-money inference.

sources.source: The National Archives' annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: The National Archives and Department for Culture, Media and Sport
sources.verified_fact: The official annual report was published on 16 July 2026 and covers The National Archives' performance over the 2025 to 2026 accounting period.
sources.quality_effect: Adds public-record stewardship and institutional-resilience context while retaining corporate-performance-versus-record-loss, archive scope, digital-versus-physical holdings and no-cyber-incident-rate guards.

sources.source: DCMS annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Department for Culture, Media and Sport
sources.verified_fact: The report was published and laid before Parliament on 15 July 2026 and covers group resource use and activities for the year ended 31 March 2026; the page instructs users to use corrected spreadsheet core tables rather than the print version for affected figures.
sources.quality_effect: Adds digital, media and online-policy governance context while retaining departmental-activity-versus-safety-outcome, group-body, corrected-table, expenditure and reporting-boundary guards.

sources.source: MHCLG annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 15 July 2026 and provides a comprehensive account of departmental and group resource use, activities and performance against objectives during 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds housing, community and local-government governance context while retaining programme-versus-local-outcome, group-body, expenditure, objective and no-building-or-parcel-risk inference guards.

sources.source: Acas annual report and accounts, 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 3 July 2026 and covers Acas activities, achievements, funding, performance, accountability, governance and staffing from April 2025 to March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds workplace-dispute prevention and conciliation context while retaining contact-versus-case, conciliation-versus-settlement, dispute-versus-harm, sector and reporting-period guards.
